title: wkjobs internals + gotchas reference
desc: T3 reference for wkjobs-ai-process-monitor: implementation internals, gotchas, wrapper/source layout, manual fallback, and dated fix history
steps: INTERNALS: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process for CommandLine+PPID, Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process for CPU% snapshot, Get-Process for WorkingSet64+Threads+SessionId
GOTCHA: loop variable is apid not pid -- PowerShell PID is a reserved automatic variable for current process ID, using it as a foreach var causes ReadOnly error
WRAPPER: wkjobs.sh (bash) + wkjobs.cmd (CMD) are relative symlinks to wkwrap.sh in same dir. Run wkwrap.sh --install to add more. See also: wkappbot skill read wkwrap-ai-native-wrappers
SOURCE: wkjobs.ps1 lives in WKAppBot/bin/wkjobs.ps1 (edit there). scripts/wkjobs.ps1 is a symlink (mode 120000). wkjobs.sh relay uses local wkwrap.sh copy so wkfind.sh keeps SDK-specific wkfind.ps1.
PATH fix: prepend system dirs before codex exec to avoid PS shim shadowing system shell

COLUMNS: PID, NAME, CPU%, MEM(MB), THR(threads), STATE, AGE, CWD (native kernel read via NtQueryInformationProcess+ReadProcessMemory), CMD (args only). TERMINAL column: Get-TerminalHost walks parent chain to find the terminal/IDE hosting the AI process.

MANUAL FALLBACK (when wkjobs hangs): Get-CimInstance Win32_Process filtered on Name -match wkappbot/claude/codex/wkchat -- shows CommandLine per process. Zombie shell chains: wkappbot taskkill --force <pids>.

LIVE CASE 2026-07-03: wktasklist.ps1's typed param() block replaced with manual $args scanning to accept -FI/-FO/-V (PowerShell form), /FI/FO/V (real tasklist.exe form), and //FI/FO/V (Git-Bash-safe escaped form, same convention as 'taskkill //F //IM'). Also added [Console]::OutputEncoding UTF8 fix so output text including Korean renders correctly instead of mojibaking across the Bash terminal boundary. Root cause: Git Bash mangled a bare /FI into a bogus Windows path before it reached PowerShell, which positionally mis-bound to $FO's ValidateSet.
